decisions.reason: Specialized water phantom for particle therapy with planned US release in 2019 and niche but growing demand.
Small volume ionization chamber is core to modern small-field dosimetry and likely retained.
Second small volume chamber complements the range for different field sizes and is likely kept.
Standard clinical ionization chamber is a staple reference product and very unlikely to drop.
Relative dosimetry chamber addresses routine QA needs and is likely kept.
Thimble ionization chamber is a classic, widely used detector and likely retained.
